description: A reified 'grounds' relation: a study that produces or grounds a piece of evidence (subject = study, object = evidence) — the SECOND hop of the provenance spine source → describes → study → grounds → evidence. Maps to the MIRA schema's grounds slot (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml on main: domain Study, range Evidence, inverse is_grounded_in). Together with tech.scios.rrgi.describes it replaced the older single-hop 'informs' relation (source→evidence), which is DELETED — no informs lexicon exists, and the spine is the only source→evidence path extractors write (MIRA's own direct link, evidence → source document, is accepted beside it since 2026-10-03 as tech.scios.rrgi.sourceDocument, and MIRA's evidence → study link as tech.scios.rrgi.observationOriginActivity): MIRA inserts the study activity between the source document and the evidence it grounds. RRGI's intentional divergence (matching supports): subject/object are dual-addressed via com.atproto.repo.strongRef (uri + cid) instead of a bare at-uri, so the edge pins exact content versions and cannot rot. NOTE: no upstream atproto lexicon exists for this type yet; authored ahead of upstream from the MIRA schema, intended to be proposed back.

subject.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the grounding node (the study). RRGI divergence from upstream's bare at-uri: com.atproto.repo.strongRef requires both uri and cid, so the CID is mandatory.

object.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the grounded node (the evidence). See subject: RRGI divergence, CID mandatory.

description.description: Optional elaboration: how the study produced or grounds this evidence.
